entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's not what I expected and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter what the issue is! I don't like it, and I want to return it. It's practically brand new.
I understand. I'll just need to pull up your order to check the eligibility. Could I get your full name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones, order number is... 774-V-F-901. Just process the refund.
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It shows the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you on December 15th. Unfortunately, it looks like it's **too late** to start a return for this item.
WHAT?! Too late? I just got it! That's insane! I haven't even had it for a month! This is ridiculous!

I understand your frustration, but our return **policy** is different for wearable electronics like the Pulse. Due to the nature of the device, it has a strict 10-day return window from the date of delivery.
Ten days?! That's a scam! I want to speak to your manager right now. This is completely unacceptable customer service.

I am the highest point of contact for this issue, as a manager would have to refer to the same policy. We can't make exceptions because this is a health and safety matter. After 10 days, for **hygiene** and bio-safety reasons, we cannot accept the product back.
Hygiene? Don't give me that garbage! I'm going to post about this everywhere. Twitter, Facebook, all the review sites. People need to know how VeloFit rips off its customers!

I'm sorry you feel that way, Sam, but the policy is firm and is in place for customer protection and **sanitation** standards. The 10-day return window is also stated clearly on the product page before purchase. I am not authorized to override it.
This is unbelievable. You've just lost a customer for life. Absolutely useless!
I do apologize that this isn't the outcome you were hoping for. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No! You haven't assisted me at all! *[customer hangs up]*
